product_overview: Web UI for monitoring and controlling the Ouroboros Runtime daemon, providing a dashboard, wave queue, agent review, analysis and settings. The UI reflects real-time daemon state and allows configuration of theme, skin, behavior and logging.
core_goals: Provide a 2x2 dashboard that surfaces runtime state and allows quick navigation to detailed views
Offer persistent navigation and status surfaces that reflect daemon connection and operational metrics in real time
Expose configuration for theme, visual skin, UI scale and behavior with persistence across sessions
Deliver a logs viewer with level/color coded entries and ability to clear logs
Support a dual-axis theming system (color scheme + visual skin) with minimal performance impact

features.name: Sidebar Navigation
features.description: Persistent left sidebar with NavLink navigation to all primary routes, daemon connection indicator and a Stop All control to halt runtime operations.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View left sidebar with OUROBOROS logo and navigation icons -> Click Waves link in sidebar -> See route /waves load
Navigate to / -> Click Agents link in sidebar -> See route /agents load -> View daemon connection status indicator in sidebar footer
Navigate to / -> Click Stop All button in sidebar -> See confirmation dialog appear -> Click Confirm in confirmation dialog -> See operations stop (daemon shows disconnected)
Navigate to / -> Hover over a sidebar NavLink -> See hover visual feedback (background or color change) -> Click the NavLink -> See pointer cursor and route change
Navigate to / -> Attempt to click Stop All when daemon already disconnected -> See confirmation dialog or disabled state -> See no additional network activity

features.name: Status Bar
features.description: Top status bar that shows daemon connection status, current wave, running tasks, token usage and operational mode with realtime updates via the RPC endpoint.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See status bar displayed at top of page

Navigate to / -> View real-time daemon connection status in status bar (Connected) -> View current wave number displayed in monospace -> View running tasks count displayed in monospace -> View token usage displayed in monospace -> Observe status values update via /api/rpc polling
Navigate to / -> Daemon becomes unreachable -> See status bar show Disconnected -> See numeric fields update to empty or dash values
Navigate to / -> Rapidly switch routes -> See status bar persist and continue updating without interruption

features.name: Dashboard Grid
features.description: Main dashboard at / presenting a responsive 2x2 grid with quadrants for Analysis, Wave Queue, Agent Review and Execution that show real data when daemon is connected or an EmptyState when disconnected.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View 2x2 quadrant grid (Analysis, Wave Queue, Agent Review, Execution)

Navigate to / -> Daemon connected -> See Analysis quadrant populated with real analysis data -> See Wave Queue quadrant populated with queue items -> See Agent Review quadrant populated with agent items -> See Execution quadrant populated with running executions
Navigate to / -> Daemon not running -> See all quadrants display EmptyState with WifiOff icon -> See message 'Daemon not connected' in each quadrant
Navigate to / -> Resize viewport to mobile width -> See grid respond to smaller layout and quadrants stack appropriately

features.name: Settings Page
features.description: Full settings page at /settings for color scheme selection, visual skin, UI scale, behavior toggles and notification controls with persistence in localStorage and a Reset button to restore defaults.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> View theme radio buttons for Dark, Light, System
Navigate to /settings -> Select theme Light -> Observe data-theme updated on root element
Navigate to /settings -> Select interface skin Functional -> Observe data-skin updated on root element -> Observe accent color change and glow removal
Navigate to /settings -> Adjust UI scale slider to 125% -> Observe UI scale update applied to layout

Navigate to /settings -> Toggle Reduced Motion on -> Toggle Auto-scroll Logs off -> Toggle Confirm before emergency brake on -> Adjust Max log entries to 500 -> Toggle Notification sounds on -> Click Save or leave (store updates automatically) -> Refresh page -> See settings persisted from localStorage
Navigate to /settings -> Click Reset -> See settings restore to default values -> Refresh page -> See defaults persist from localStorage
Navigate to /settings -> Select Swiss skin -> Observe some components render incorrectly or display partial light-mode styling (known limitation)

features.name: Logs Viewer
features.description: Logs page at /logs showing daemon and agent log entries with level, timestamp and message, color-coded by level and supporting clearing of logs and an EmptyState when there are no entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /logs -> View list of log entries with level, timestamp and message
Navigate to /logs -> See entries color-coded by level (info blue, warn yellow, error red)
Navigate to /logs -> Click Clear button -> See all log entries removed -> See EmptyState with InboxIcon
Navigate to /logs -> No logs exist -> See EmptyState with InboxIcon displayed
Navigate to /logs -> Use filtering controls (if present) -> See list update to match filter selection

features.name: Theme System
features.description: Dual-axis theming system combining a color scheme (dark/light/system) and a visual skin (snake/functional/swiss). theme and skin are applied via data-theme and data-skin attributes on the root and persisted to localStorage.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Switch color scheme to Dark -> Observe data-theme attribute on root set to dark -> Observe UI colors change to dark variants
Navigate to /settings -> Switch skin to Functional -> Observe data-skin attribute on root set to functional -> Observe accent change to #3B82F6 and removal of glow effects
Navigate to /settings -> Switch skin to Swiss -> Observe data-skin attribute set to swiss -> Observe that some components may not fully render correct light variants (known limitation)
Navigate to /settings -> Change theme and skin -> Refresh page -> Observe theme and skin persisted and reapplied from localStorage

known_limitations.issue: Dashboard quadrants show "Daemon not connected" when backend daemon is not running on port 3001
known_limitations.impact: All 4 quadrants display empty state - no data visible without daemon

known_limitations.issue: Vite proxy errors flood console when daemon is not running
known_limitations.impact: Repeated ECONNREFUSED errors every 5 seconds to /api/rpc

known_limitations.issue: Swiss skin only applies data-theme="swiss" without full light mode support for all components
known_limitations.impact: Some components may not render correctly in swiss theme

known_limitations.issue: Functional skin CSS overrides are limited to accent color and glow removal
known_limitations.impact: Some snake-themed elements may still show through in functional skin
